acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves current indexed coverage for the declared governance-document scope; it does not prove document correctness or human ratification.
evidenceRequired: Codebase Memory coverage reports current metadata for every declared material governance document.
A regression or validation step fails with GRAPH_COVERAGE_BLOCKED when any required document is excluded, stale, skipped, partial, pending, or unknown.

completionCriteria: Material governance documents are indexable or have a repository-approved equivalent evidence path.
Coverage checks enumerate every document used for architecture, authority, trust, or readiness conclusions.
Excluded, stale, skipped, partial, pending, or unknown document coverage produces GRAPH_COVERAGE_BLOCKED instead of a completeness claim.
Graph coverage remains explicitly separate from document correctness, authority ratification, and runtime proof.
nonObjectives: Do not treat graph inclusion as proof that a document is correct or current.
Do not silently bypass graph gaps with direct filesystem reads during exploration.
Do not broaden indexing to secrets, generated binaries, or unrelated artifacts.
objective: Remove the documentation graph-coverage blind spot without weakening evidence-tier reporting.
title: Make governance documentation graph-verifiable
